title: Interest-rate tiers explained
summary: Explains how interest-rate tiers work: balances below $10,000 earn 2.5% APY, while balances at or above $10,000 earn 4.0% APY. Your daily ending balance is checked each day, and interest accrues and compounds daily.
faqs: How is my APY determined each day?
